Project production gates

Reusable production system
One global pipeline across all projects, with manual approval before publishing.

          

            
01 · SCRIPT
Write and time each episode to its target length.

            
02 · REFERENCE
Approve cast and world designs; lock model, seed, and prompts.

            
03 · CLIPS
Generate short shots and track each asset and cost.

            
04 · EDIT
Voice, lip sync, SFX, music, captions, and full review.

            
05 · POST
Human approval, native scheduling, and performance log.

          

          
Automation later

          
A future version can connect project records to an optional automation service for asset naming, shot checklists, review reminders, and analytics. Export JSON as an independent backup.

        


        

          
Production tools
Your private tools plus admin tools assigned to you.

          

          

          
Cost and rights

          
Cloud video credits and free exports can change. Keep clean masters and approved character references. Use music with rights for every platform where you publish.
